power.neoorigins.kraken_deep_current.des: We jina yiyara ju eyikeyi dada dweller.
power.neoorigins.kraken_pressure_armor.d: Yẹ Resistance I - jin-okun Ìbòmọlẹ itumọ ti fun crushing titẹ.
power.neoorigins.kraken_regen_in_water.d: Larada 2 HP fun iṣẹju kan lakoko ti o wa ninu omi.
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.name: Etikun
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.descript: Gbigbe 30% losokepupo lori ilẹ - ko kọ fun rin.
O gba ibajẹ 1 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
Pe olutọju kan lati ja fun ọ. Max 2 ni ẹẹkan. Awọn idiyele 5 pataki. 20-keji itutu. O gba ibajẹ 1 ti o ba ku ni ija.
power.neoorigins.kraken_massive.name: Colossal
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.name: Gbigbe Jade
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.descri: Afẹfẹ ami si isalẹ nigba ti o ba jade ninu omi: dada gun ju ati awọn ti o suffocate. Ojo, cauldron omi kan, Mimi omi tabi omi ti nṣiṣe lọwọ ti o wa nitosi gbogbo wọn mu kuro.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_summon_guardian: Pe olutọju kan lati ja fun ọ. Max 2 ni ẹẹkan. Awọn idiyele 5 pataki. 20-keji itutu. O gba ibajẹ 1 ti o ba ku ni ija.
origins.neoorigins.warden.name: Alabojuto
origins.neoorigins.warden.description: Ti a bi lati inu okunkun nla - ni imọlara agbaye nipasẹ awọn gbigbọn, ṣe agbega ariwo sonic ni ibiti o wa, o si lu bi àgbo battering. Lumbering ati irora nipa orun.
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.name: Ìbúgbàù Ohùn
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.descr: Ina bugbamu sonic apanirun kan (ibajẹ idan 8 + Slowness III ni agbegbe 10-block). Awọn idiyele 4 stamina. 20-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.warden_echolocation.des: Awọn nkan alãye ti o wa nitosi n tan, ti o han paapaa nipasẹ awọn odi.
power.neoorigins.warden_tremor_sense.des: Awọn oye awọn nkan ti o jinna - ni gbogbo iṣẹju-aaya 2, ohunkohun laarin awọn bulọọki 24 nmọlẹ fun iṣẹju-aaya 3.
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.name: Agbara Okunkun Jin
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.descrip: Awọn adehun 4 afikun bibajẹ fun buruju.
power.neoorigins.warden_ancient_hide.des: Yẹ Resistance II — primordial ẹran ara ati ipon sculk plating foju julọ bibajẹ.
power.neoorigins.warden_night_vision.des: Ṣe akiyesi agbaye nipasẹ awọn gbigbọn - okunkun ko ṣe pataki.
O gba ibajẹ 1 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.name: Igi igi
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.descri: Gbigbe 30% losokepupo ju deede - apanirun ṣugbọn ipa ipadanu.
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.name: Arara
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.description: A stout ipamo oníṣẹ ọnà - iwapọ, armored, ati tireless ni Forge, sugbon kukuru-limbed ati ki o lọra lori dada.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_compact_frame.des: 80% iwọn ti ẹrọ orin deede - ni ibamu nipasẹ awọn aaye wiwọ.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stout_constitutio: Resistance Yẹ I - isan iwuwo ati egungun ko ni so eso ni irọrun.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.name: Okunkun
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.descri: Le ri kedere ni lapapọ òkunkun - a s'aiye si ipamo. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.name: Awọn ẹsẹ ti o lagbara
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.descr: Gbigbe 15% losokepupo - kukuru ṣugbọn awọn ẹsẹ duro.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.name: Òkúta ńfọ̀
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.desc: Awọn bulọọki awọn bulọọki 25% yiyara - awọn ọwọ adaṣe lori eyikeyi ohun elo.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.name: Awọn apa kukuru
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.descr: Dina ibaraenisepo ibiti o dinku nipasẹ 0.5 - awọn apa kukuru, dimu to lagbara.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_mining_hunger.des: Nlo 25% dinku ebi lati gbogbo awọn iṣẹ ṣiṣe - ti a ṣe fun ifarada.
Funni a dwarven irin pickaxe (Unbreaking II, Iṣiṣẹ I) nigba ti o ba yan yi Oti.
origins.neoorigins.breeze.name: Afẹfẹ
origins.neoorigins.breeze.description: Ẹda ti afẹfẹ ti a bi ni Awọn Iyẹwu Idanwo - yara, afẹfẹ, ati ihamọra pẹlu awọn gusts, ṣugbọn ina ati ẹlẹgẹ.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.name: Agbara afẹfẹ
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.desc: Ṣe ifilọlẹ iṣẹ akanṣe afẹfẹ ti o kọlu awọn ọta pada. 5-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.name: Afẹfẹ Dash
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.descri: Bursts siwaju lori gust ti afẹfẹ. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.breeze_no_fall_damage.d: Toggleable: afẹfẹ mu ọ bi o ti ṣubu. Tan-an nipa aiyipada - yi lọ kuro pẹlu bọtini olorijori lati de awọn deba to ṣe pataki.
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.name: Igbesoke
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.descr: Toggleable: gusts gbe fo rẹ ga (Jump Boost II). Lori nipasẹ aiyipada - yi lọ kuro pẹlu bọtini olorijori ti o ba fẹ giga fo deede.
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.name: Afẹfẹ iru
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.desc: Gbigbe ni iyara 15% - afẹfẹ n gbe ọ siwaju.
power.neoorigins.breeze_reduced_health.d: -4 ọkàn (-8 max HP). Ara afẹfẹ jẹ awọ ara rara.
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.name: Ina fireemu
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.desc: 90% iwọn ti ẹrọ orin deede - ina ati airy.
origins.neoorigins.vampire.name: Fanpaya
origins.neoorigins.vampire.description: Apanirun ti a ko tii ti oru - yara, lagbara, ati ebi npa ayeraye. Imọlẹ oorun jẹ irora, omi n jo, ati ẹran-ara aise nikan ni o ṣe atilẹyin fun ọ.
power.neoorigins.vampire_entity_group.de: Sọsọtọ bi undead. Ipalara nipasẹ Ilera Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, mu larada nipasẹ Bibajẹ Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, ajesara si Majele.
power.neoorigins.vampire_water_breathing: Ko nilo lati simi. Le ye laelae labẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.vampire_night_vision.de: Le ri kedere ni lapapọ òkunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.vampire_attack_bonus.de: Awọn adehun 2 afikun bibajẹ fun buruju.
power.neoorigins.vampire_speed_boost.des: Gbigbe ni iyara 15% - blur ni imọlẹ oṣupa.
power.neoorigins.vampire_daylight_damage: Mu ina ati ki o gba ibaje 2 fun iṣẹju kan ni imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.name: Òkú Vitality
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.desc: Isọdọtun ilera adayeba ti dinku si 40% ti deede.
power.neoorigins.vampire_food_restrictio: Le nikan je eran aise, ẹran ti o jẹjẹ, ati oju alantakun.
power.neoorigins.vampire_blood_diet_bonu: Eran aise ati ti o ti bajẹ yoo fun ọ ni itọju bi ẹnipe a ti jinna tuntun.
Mu 1 bibajẹ fun iṣẹju kan nigba ti omi tabi ojo.
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.name: Aderubaniyan Tamer
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.descrip: Aláìbẹ̀rù ẹranko tí ń mú àwọn jàǹdùkú ọ̀tá tẹ̀ sí ìfẹ́ inú wọn. Nikan wọn jẹ alailagbara, ṣugbọn pẹlu idii aduroṣinṣin ni ẹgbẹ wọn, wọn jẹ agbara lati ni iṣiro.
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.name: Jọba
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.descript: Wo agbajo eniyan ọta ki o muu ṣiṣẹ lati tẹ si ifẹ rẹ. Yoo tẹle ọ yoo daabobo ọ. Max 4 tamed mobs. Awọn idiyele 3 koko. 10-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.name: Nitoribẹẹ
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.desc: Wo ibi-afẹde kan ki o mu ṣiṣẹ lati paṣẹ fun gbogbo idii rẹ lati kọlu rẹ. 2-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.name: Ìsopọ̀ ẹgbẹ́
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.descr: Rẹ tamed mobs laiyara regenerate 1 HP gbogbo 6 aaya nigba ti jade ti ija.
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.name: Ailagbara nikan
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.descri: Mu 25% dinku ibajẹ melee - o gbẹkẹle idii rẹ lati ja.
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.name: Ifunni Pack
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.desc: Ebi npa 50% yiyara lati igara ti mimu mnu rẹ.
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.no_target: Ko si agbajo eniyan ni oju.
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.blacklisted: Ẹ̀dá yẹn kò lè fìyà jẹ!
power.neoorigins.mount.not_allowed_playe: Agbara yii ko le fojusi awọn oṣere.
power.neoorigins.mount.not_allowed_mobs: Agbara yii ko le dojukọ awọn agbajo eniyan.
power.neoorigins.mount.already_ridden: Ẹya yẹn ti ni ẹlẹṣin tẹlẹ!
power.neoorigins.mount.no_request: O ko ni awọn ibeere oke ni isunmọtosi.
power.neoorigins.mount.requester_offline: Ẹrọ orin ti o beere ko si lori ayelujara.
power.neoorigins.mount.too_far: Ẹrọ orin ti o beere ti jinna pupọ.
power.neoorigins.command_pack.no_pack: O ni ko si tamed mobs!
power.neoorigins.command_pack.success: Paṣẹ awọn agbajo eniyan %s lati kọlu %s!
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.name: Mage ilẹ
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.descriptio: A stalwart geomancer ti o slams ilẹ lati rupture ọtá ati ki o gbe okuta Odi ni a idari. Immovable bi òke, ṣugbọn aiye di wọn sunmọ - omi ati awọn giga ni o wa ko ọrẹ wọn.
Slam ilẹ ayé, ṣe ibaje 6 ati kọlu gbogbo awọn nkan ti o wa nitosi. Awọn idiyele 3 mana. 6-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_stone_wall.d: Gbe okuta okuta okuta kan si ibi ti o n wa. 2-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.name: Fidimule
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.descr: Mu 50% kere si knockback - duro bi ibusun.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.name: Eru
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.descri: Ko le we - o rì bi okuta kan.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_earthbound.d: Mu 50% ibajẹ isubu diẹ sii. Ilẹ tun gba tirẹ.
origins.neoorigins.water_mage.name: Omi Mage
